## [CN]规则
## [EN]Rule

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 所有发布到外部仓库的代码（包括但不限于 CocoaPods、Swift Package Manager、Carthage、Maven / Gradle、npm、pub.dev、ohpm、微信小程序 npm 包）都必须在包内带上协议声明（本仓库根目录的 `LICENSE`，MIT）。包已有内置的资源包文件夹时放入其中（iOS 的 `.bundle`、Android 的 Java 资源 `META-INF/<模块名>/`、小程序的组件目录）；没有时新建一个，或放在包的根目录（npm、pub.dev、ohpm 会发布包根目录的 `LICENSE`）。适用于所有平台。新增一个发布包时，同时把它加入下表与 `scripts/check-license-notices.py`。 | All code published to an outside registry (including but not limited to CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, Carthage, Maven / Gradle, npm, pub.dev, ohpm and the WeChat Mini Program npm package) must ship its license notice inside the package (the repository's root `LICENSE`, MIT). When the package has a built-in resource folder, the license goes into it (an iOS `.bundle`, Android Java resources under `META-INF/<module>/`, a mini program component folder); when it has none, create one, or put the license at the package root (npm, pub.dev and ohpm publish the package root's `LICENSE`). This applies to every platform. A new published package is added to the table below and to `scripts/check-license-notices.py` in the same change. |
| 检查：`python3 scripts/check-license-notices.py`，缺少协议文件时以 1 退出并列出每个缺失的文件。 | Check: `python3 scripts/check-license-notices.py`; it exits 1 and names each missing file. |

## [CN]各发布包
## [EN]Packages

| 仓库 / Registry | 包 / Package | 协议文件 / License file | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| CocoaPods、SwiftPM、Carthage | `CYLTabBarController` | `CYLTabBarController/Resources/CYLTabBarController.bundle/LICENSE` | 随资源包发布（podspec 的 `resources`、SwiftPM 的 `.copy`、framework target 的文件夹引用）。2026-11-17 新增。 | Published with the resource bundle (the podspec's `resources`, SwiftPM's `.copy`, the framework target's folder reference). Added 2026-11-17. |
| CocoaPods、SwiftPM、Carthage | `CYLAnimatedItem` | `CYLTabBarController/CYLAnimatedItem/Resources/CYLAnimatedItem.bundle/LICENSE`（及 `POLICY.md`） | 随组件的资源包发布。 | Published with the component's resource bundle. |
| CocoaPods、SwiftPM、Carthage | `CYLBadge` | `CYLTabBarController/CYLBadgeView/Resources/CYLBadge.bundle/LICENSE` | 随角标库的资源包发布，只含 LICENSE。2026-11-28 新增。 | Published with the badge library's resource bundle, which holds only the LICENSE. Added 2026-11-28. |
| CocoaPods、SwiftPM、Carthage | `CYLUtils` | `CYLTabBarController/Resources/CYLTabBarController.bundle/LICENSE` | 随最底层 pod 的资源包发布（整个库共用的 `CYLTabBarController.bundle`，只由 CYLUtils 列出）。2026-11-28 新增。 | Published with the bottom pod's resource bundle (the library-wide `CYLTabBarController.bundle`, listed by CYLUtils only). Added 2026-11-28. |
| Maven / Gradle | `cyltabbarcontroller` | `Example-Android/cyltabbar/src/main/resources/META-INF/cyltabbar/LICENSE` | Java 资源，进入 AAR 的 `classes.jar`；React Native 与 Flutter 的源码构建也加入该资源目录。2026-11-17 新增。 | A Java resource, packed into the AAR's `classes.jar`; the React Native and Flutter source builds add this resource folder too. Added 2026-11-17. |
| Maven / Gradle | `cyltabbarcontroller-animateditem` | `Example-Android/cylanimateditem/src/main/resources/META-INF/cylanimateditem/LICENSE`（及 `POLICY.md`） | Java 资源，同上。 | A Java resource, as above. |
| npm | `react-native-cyltabbar` | `CrossPlatform/react-native-cyltabbar/LICENSE` | npm 总会发布包根目录的 `LICENSE`。 | npm always publishes the package root's `LICENSE`. |
| pub.dev | `flutter_cyltabbar` | `CrossPlatform/flutter_cyltabbar/LICENSE` | pub.dev 要求包根目录有 `LICENSE`。 | pub.dev requires a `LICENSE` at the package root. |
| ohpm | `cyltabbar` | `CrossPlatform/harmonyos-cyltabbar/cyltabbar/LICENSE` | 包根目录。2026-11-17 新增。 | The package root. Added 2026-11-17. |
| ohpm | `cylanimateditem` | `CrossPlatform/harmonyos-cyltabbar/cylanimateditem/LICENSE` | 包根目录（鸿蒙版动效组件）。2026-11-17 新增。 | The package root (the HarmonyOS animated item component). Added 2026-11-17. |
| npm（微信小程序） / npm (WeChat Mini Program) | `wechat-miniprogram-cyltabbar` | `CrossPlatform/wechat-miniprogram-cyltabbar/LICENSE`、`…/src/LICENSE` | 包根目录（`files` 已列出）与组件目录 `src`（开发者工具构建 npm 时复制到 `miniprogram_npm`）。`src/LICENSE` 于 2026-11-17 新增。 | The package root (listed in `files`) and the component folder `src` (copied into `miniprogram_npm` when DevTools builds npm). `src/LICENSE` added 2026-11-17. |
| Maven / Gradle | `cyltabbarcontroller-pages` | `Example-Android/tabpages/src/main/resources/META-INF/tabpages/LICENSE` | 纯 Kotlin 模块的 Java 资源，进入 JAR。2026-11-17 新增。 | A Java resource of the pure Kotlin module, packed into its JAR. Added 2026-11-17. |
| npm（微信小程序） / npm (WeChat Mini Program) | `gif-miniprogram`、`lottie-miniprogram`、`pag-miniprogram`、`rive-miniprogram`、`svga-miniprogram` | `CrossPlatform/<包>/LICENSE`、`…/miniprogram_dist/LICENSE` | 包根目录（`files` 已列出）与组件目录 `miniprogram_dist`（`package.json` 的 `miniprogram`，构建 npm 时复制进 App）；`lottie-miniprogram` 的 webpack 构建会复制它。随包附带的第三方库保留各自的协议（如 `miniprogram_dist/libpag/LICENSE.txt`）。`miniprogram_dist/LICENSE` 于 2026-11-17 新增。 | The package root (listed in `files`) and the component folder `miniprogram_dist` (`miniprogram` in `package.json`, copied into the app when npm is built); `lottie-miniprogram`'s webpack build copies it. Vendored third-party libraries keep their own license (e.g. `miniprogram_dist/libpag/LICENSE.txt`). `miniprogram_dist/LICENSE` added 2026-11-17. |
